backlog.title: Fix sync overwriting recent edits
backlog.reasoning: The most frequent complaint with the highest severity. Data loss drives one-star reviews and cancellations, and it began with release 4.2.
backlog.user_impact: Users lose work when switching devices and stop trusting the app with important notes.
backlog.suggested_fix: Add per-paragraph version vectors, keep both versions on conflict and show a merge prompt. Add an automated multi-device sync test to the release checklist.
evidence_quotes: I edited my meeting notes on the iPad, opened the phone and everything I wrote was gone. Sync rolled it back.
Twice this week my latest edits were replaced by an older copy from my laptop. I no longer trust it.

backlog.title: Speed up start-up and search for large libraries
backlog.reasoning: Second largest negative theme. Power users with big libraries are the most likely to pay for Pro.
backlog.user_impact: Opening the app or searching takes several seconds once a library passes a few thousand notes.
backlog.suggested_fix: Load the note list lazily, move the search index to a background full-text index and show cached results first.
evidence_quotes: With about 6,000 notes the app takes 8 seconds to open. It used to be instant.
Search across my archive freezes for a few seconds before results show up.

backlog.title: Revisit what the Pro plan includes
backlog.reasoning: Pricing reviews are almost entirely negative and mention cancelling. Moving export and tags behind the paywall caused most of the anger.
backlog.user_impact: Long-time users feel features were taken away and are leaving for cheaper alternatives.
backlog.suggested_fix: Return PDF export and tags to the free tier, and add a student discount and family plan.
evidence_quotes: Features I used for years are now Pro only and the price went up. Feels like a bait and switch.
The new Pro plan costs more than competitors with fewer features.

backlog.title: Add a high contrast dark theme
backlog.reasoning: Accessibility issue affecting readability for low-vision users. Small effort for a clear improvement.
backlog.user_impact: Some users cannot read notes or code blocks in the dark theme.
backlog.suggested_fix: Raise body text contrast to at least 4.5:1, restyle code blocks and add a high contrast option in Settings.
evidence_quotes: Grey text on dark grey is very low contrast. Code blocks are almost invisible.
I have low vision and the dark theme is unreadable for me.

backlog.title: Support pencil handwriting on tablets
backlog.reasoning: Frequent, mostly positive requests from tablet users. It is a growth opportunity rather than a source of churn.
backlog.user_impact: Tablet users keep a second app for handwritten notes and sketches.
backlog.suggested_fix: Add an ink canvas block with pencil support, then add handwriting recognition to search.
evidence_quotes: Would be perfect on iPad if I could write with the pencil and search my handwriting.
Everything is great except there is no way to sketch or handwrite.

backlog.title: Allow account deletion in the app
backlog.reasoning: Few reviews, but app store policies require in-app account deletion, so the risk is high.
backlog.user_impact: Users who want to leave cannot remove their data without contacting support.
backlog.suggested_fix: Add Delete account to Settings with a confirmation step and an export prompt.
evidence_quotes: There is no way to delete my account from inside the app.

backlog.title: Reduce upsell banners on the free tier
backlog.reasoning: A small but growing complaint that adds to the pricing frustration.
backlog.user_impact: Free users see a Pro banner on every screen, which makes the app feel cluttered.
backlog.suggested_fix: Show the upgrade prompt only when a Pro feature is tapped, and at most once a week otherwise.
evidence_quotes: The free tier now shows a Pro banner on every screen.

competitors.name: Lanternbook
competitors.summary: A fictional cross-platform notes app in this sample, known for reliable sync and a generous free tier.
strengths: Conflict-free sync with visible version history
Free tier includes export and tags
opportunities: Match its sync reliability and keep the cleaner editor as the differentiator
Market the quick capture widget, which it lacks

competitors.name: Quillstack
competitors.summary: A fictional tablet-first notes app in this sample, popular for handwriting and sketching.
strengths: Excellent pencil input with handwriting search
opportunities: Offer a lightweight ink block to win tablet users without losing the writing focus
Introduce student pricing to answer price complaints
